name: Windows Defender Operational Log
purpose: Records Defender detections, remediation actions, and Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) rule activity.
normal_baseline: Occasional benign PUA detections consistent with normal software use; ASR audit events for known, tuned exceptions.
anomalies: 1116/1117 detection for a known offensive tool followed by no corresponding removal confirmation
ASR block (112x series) for a LOLBin invocation
anti_forensic_notes: A detected-and-quarantined threat still generates a 1116/1117 record even if the file itself is gone, making this log valuable when malware self-deletes; excluded paths configured via GPO produce no detection at all.
